level: native local TCP/HTTPS/mTLS + offline default Host
existingBaseline: 32-byte random tokens, digest storage, client revision rotation, exact Host/Origin, TLS/proxy modes and bounded per-source cooling already existed before this change

changes.anonymous: Bounded per-TCP-peer exponential cooling plus a separate fixed global anonymous failure window; forwarded addresses/client IDs cannot reset or establish identity
changes.authenticated: A separate bounded request window keyed by verified Store clientId/revision covers control and all grants; valid credentials bypass anonymous quotas; another client remains usable and local rotation resets the old revision window
changes.credentials: Clients and grants both perform fixed-size digest comparisons, including absent-row dummy comparisons; invalid wire credentials receive uniform AUTH_INVALID/401
changes.response: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT/429 includes bounded Retry-After. Repeated cooling failures do not refill audit. Tokens are absent from persisted clients/grants/audit
changes.network: Strict bind/list bounds; exact Origin/Host and actual proxy peer, precise HTTPS forwarding marker, no forwarded Host/source trust; mTLS requires explicit CA plus independent Bearer

checks: bounded source/global/client counters and 30-second exponential cap with Host-only fake clock
real HTTP spoofed source/client headers cannot reset cooling; valid shared peer survives and window recovers
real HTTP global anonymous saturation leaves valid control/MCP clients usable; repeated rejections do not fill audit
real HTTP multiple tickets share actual client quota; other client remains usable; live local rotation immediately invalidates old secrets/tickets
real HTTP trusted proxy peer, exact TLS marker, exact Host/Origin and configuration rejection
real HTTPS trusted CA succeeds, missing Bearer fails and untrusted server certificate is refused
real mutual TLS requires a trusted client certificate and separate Bearer; missing/untrusted client certificates fail

intermediateFailures: An initial HTTP cooling test used a 500ms window, shorter than cold MCP initialization; warmed the native path first and used a 2s constrained test window. Deterministic component checks still verify exact production backoff values.
First remote capability commands passed shell text where the private helper expected a local script path; corrected to explicit .sh/.ps1 files before remote execution.
limitations: This checkpoint is local Windows11/Node24.20.0. Ubuntu Node22 and Win10 Node24 are reachable; fresh source synchronization/reruns follow in separate evidence
TLS/mTLS uses ephemeral OpenSSL-generated test certificates and actual local sockets; no public service, VPN or Tunnel deployment is implied
Limits are bounded process-local state, reset on cold restart and subject to idle/LRU eviction at configured capacity; no distributed denial-of-service or full load acceptance claim
Authenticated request cap is per paired client, so all its grants share it; operators must observe Retry-After or rotate locally. Production capacity/load and Host retry UX remain separate work
